A growing, version-controlled database of **reproducible analysis case studies**
built on the [PhysioExperiment](https://github.com/x-biosignal) ecosystem and
public data. Each case states a proposition, answers a question on a public
dataset, and completes through to figures and a conclusion — with every number
traced to an artifact and the whole recipe replayable byte-identically. Cases
that raise an important unresolved question are escalated to a paper.

::: {.callout-note}
Each card links to a self-contained case: narrative, verified run bundle, and
the supporting artifacts. See the case-unit contract in `SCHEMA.md`. For a
cross-cutting view — every method, the field-standard reference it was checked
against, and the public data used — see the **[Coverage map](coverage.qmd)**.
:::
